title: 来一碗面
target: ordering: 碗, 还是, 辣, 带走
curriculumStatus: Beginner prototype; HSK level mapping and native-speaker review pending

nodes.pinyin: Huānyíng guānglín! Xiǎng chī shénme miàn?
nodes.en: Welcome! What noodles would you like?
nodes.note: 碗 (wǎn) is a bowl, and the measure word for a bowl of food. 来一碗… is a casual way to order.
nodes.speaker: cook
nodes.hint: Name a dish: 我要一碗牛肉面。

nodes.note: 还是 (háishi) means 'or' in a question.
nodes.speaker: cook
nodes.hint: Answer 大碗 or 小碗.

nodes.speaker: cook
nodes.hint: 辣 (là) is spicy. 微辣 (wēi là) is mildly spicy; 不要辣 is not spicy.

nodes.pinyin: Zài zhèr chī háishi dài zǒu?
nodes.note: 打包 (dǎbāo, to pack up) is another common way to ask for takeaway.
nodes.speaker: cook
nodes.hint: 带走 (dài zǒu) is to take away; 在这儿吃 is to eat here.

served-here.note: 慢慢吃 (literally 'eat slowly') is how people say 'enjoy your meal'.
served-here.speaker: cook

served-takeaway.en: Here you go. Careful, it's hot!
served-takeaway.speaker: cook

cant-afford.pinyin: Bù hǎoyìsi, qián hǎoxiàng bú gòu.
cant-afford.en: Sorry, that doesn't seem to be enough money.
cant-afford.speaker: cook

cancelled.pinyin: Méi guānxi, xià cì zài lái!
cancelled.en: No problem, come again next time!
cancelled.speaker: cook

recipe.zh: 第一次来吧？教你做个家常的番茄鸡蛋面，回家试试！
recipe.pinyin: Dì yī cì lái ba? Jiāo nǐ zuò ge jiācháng de fānqié jīdàn miàn, huí jiā shìshi!
recipe.en: First time here? Let me teach you a simple home dish, tomato and egg noodles. Try it at home!
recipe.speaker: cook
